evidence: Receiving DO2 minimum ~8.9 mg/L at t=24.8h, well above 2.0 mg/L constraint
Receiving P at t=48h = 3.16 g/L, matching source batches (3.06, 3.02, 2.98 g/L)
DO2 trajectory (14.6 -> 11.7 mg/L with transient dip at t~24h) mirrors all three source batches
t=52h DO2 = 11.7 mg/L, stable and healthy
args.rationale: Receiving fermentation is nominal: DO2 well above the 2.0 mg/L minimum throughout (min ~8.9 mg/L), product trajectory at 48h (3.16 g/L) matches or slightly exceeds the source-batch envelope, and no anomaly is present. No intervention is warranted; KEEP preserves product mass and avoids oxygen-constraint risk.
args.uncertainty: Hidden receiving parameters or late-run divergence cannot be excluded, but all available public observations through t=52h are consistent with a healthy batch; risk of missing a problem appears low.
